name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 52 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2025-12-08, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.11 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
